repo.title: Testcommand
repo.description: Testcommand that is used for simple testing. Will append the current date to a text file in your home directory

repo.title: Volume +5%
repo.cmd: osascript -e "set volume output volume (output volume of (get volume settings) + 5)"
repo.description: Turns up the volume by 5% using AppleScript

repo.title: Volume -5%
repo.cmd: osascript -e "set volume output volume (output volume of (get volume settings) - 5)"
repo.description: Turns down the volume by 5% using AppleScript
